newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-ISRAELI FIRST DIVISION PLAYER DIES DURING MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ISRAELI FIRST DIVISION PLAYER DIES DURING MATCH.

text.p: Wahib Jabara of Hapoel Taibe, the only Arab club in the Israeli National League, collapsed and died during a match on Friday, local emergency medical services said.
Jabara, 23, had been playing for his side in a scheduled league match with Bnei Yehuda at Taibe's home ground in the Arab town of Umm el-Fahm and fell to the ground after about half an hour's play.
He was pronounced dead by an intensive care ambulance unit on the way to Haemek Hospital in the northern town of Afula following resuscitation attempts on the pitch.

"The player lost conciousness and collapsed during play. There were no signs of any previous problems during the match," paramedic Yossi Pahima of Afula's Magen David Adom ambulance service told Reuters.
The match was subsequently abandoned by referee Arik Haimowitz.
Hapoel Taibe is the first club from Israel's Arab sector to play in the National League but are bottom of the league and face almost certain relegation.
